Authorised.description: What a route's access check settled: the caller's principal, its access to the tenant, and the IRI of the tenant or aggregate it was checked on, which the route then acts on, and the global roles the token granted the caller.

global_roles.description: The system-level roles the token grants the principal.

type.description: The class of the node: its name or IRI. Set by the service on a read; a write may name the class or one of its subclasses.

EventEnvelope.description: What travels beside an activity on the event bus: the tenant it happened in, the deployment that published it, the class of its body and where to find the JSON-LD context that reads it.

context.description: A link to the JSON-LD context that reads the message body.

tenant.description: The IRI of the tenant, or of the application, the activity happened in.

type.description: The class of the node: its name or IRI. Set by the service on a read; a write may name the class or one of its subclasses.
